definitions.explanation: The department of a magazine, newspaper or publisher that plans and edits its content, and the staff who work there.

examples.japanese: {編集部|へんしゅうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}する→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{編集部|へんしゅうぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: My older sister works in a magazine's editorial department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{編集部|へんしゅうぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一通|いっつう}→一通：26154_ittsuu⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: The editorial staff read every comment from readers, one by one.

notes:
⟦{編集|へんしゅう}→編集：04439_henshuu⟧ (editing) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (department). In a magazine, a note signed 〜{編集部|へんしゅうぶ} is written by the staff as a group.
